_comment: Monsoon rain (Session 7). Rain comes and goes by itself: after a dry spell of dryMinutes [min, max] real minutes it rains for rainMinutes [min, max]. fadeSeconds = how long it takes to start / stop. startRaining: true = a new game starts in the rain (for testing).

drops._comment: Rain drops: count per quality (low / medium / high), box = metres around the camera (width, height), speed m/s, length m, colour and opacity.

wet._comment: How rain changes the look: roads and walls darken (darken = 0-1 at full rain), fog comes closer (fogFactor) and greyer (fogColor mix), the sun gets weaker (sunFactor), the sky greys out (skyTint).

thunder._comment: Lightning flash + thunder during heavy rain. everySeconds = [min, max].
